Jasmine — quick take from ops/PS standpoint:

- Recommendation: Default to portal-first (single source-of-truth) with daily digest email copies. Portal primary gives better archival/traceability, signed PDFs can be stored and downloaded, and we can publish XML payloads via secure API or file transfer.
- For customers who require immediate posting to ERP, we support an "individual email" mode with XML attached (schema v1 in our docs).
- Sender authority: prefer canonical sender billing@redwood.com for legal provenance and DKIM/SPF alignment. We can set a "Reply-To" to the customer's account contact if they want responses routed elsewhere.
- XML payload: include InvoiceNumber, PONumber, TaxAmount, VATRegistration, and TaxScheme elements. We'll map VATRegistration to the ERP field they referenced.

Operational notes: adding daily digest reduces per-email IO and is easier for high-volume customers, but some enterprise ERPs require single-invoice messages for automatic posting — we'll support both.

I'll attach the internal digest spec and an example xml.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice-digest-spec.md (text/markdown), acme-invoice-sample.xml (application/xml)

Thanks Ben. A couple of legal/compliance points to call out for Acme:

- If we use billing@redwood.com as the canonical sender we need to ensure the domain's legal remit lines up with the issuer on the invoice (company name + legal address). For customers with country-specific VAT rules we sometimes need a localized sender or a line in the invoice stating "Issued by Redwood Inference on behalf of {Entity}".
- Signed PDFs: we can apply a cert-stamp at generation time. For EU customers we need to keep a signed archival copy for 10 years — note to product.
- For Acme specifically (their country code on VAT is US but they process EU entities): Confirm if they require VATRegistration on the invoice header and whether they want reverse-charge flagged.

Operational ask for engineering: if we support both digest and single invoice emails, add a metadata field in the XML called DeliveryMode with values DIGEST|SINGLE so their ERP can branch processing.

Kimberly Park
